articles.title: Diwali, the Festival of Lights, Is Celebrated Today
articles.summary: Diwali, the Festival of Lights, falls today, November 8. More than a billion people celebrate it with lamps, fireworks, feasts, and prayers marking the victory of light over darkness.

articles.title: New Scholarships Will Help Foster Care Students Go to College
articles.summary: Melania Trump and LSU announced scholarships for students who grew up in foster care, backed by more than $7 million in private donations. Fourteen scholars are at LSU this semester.

articles.title: Homelessness in the US Fell the Most in More Than a Decade
articles.summary: US homelessness dropped more than 6% in 2025 — about 49,000 fewer people — the largest fall in over a decade. The two sides disagree on what caused it, and nearly 700,000 people are still without housing.
